n1e70dfc3bc.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock benchmark, covering the country's largest listed companies. Retail investor holdings and sentiment can shape how quickly the market recovers after a sell-off.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The article reports the index trading below 7,000 and describes weak sentiment and retail holdings bought during the decline.

n04b1255898.summary: SK Hynix labor and management have provisionally agreed on wages and collective bargaining terms. The deal pays 60% of profit sharing in treasury shares and 40% in cash, according to industry sources.
n04b1255898.why: SK Hynix is a major South Korean memory chip maker and a key supplier to global technology companies. Employee compensation and share buybacks or distributions affect its capital structure and labor relations.
